title.value: Reconcile bank transactions in Xero with ChatGPT agent mode

introduction.value: Two accountants tested ChatGPT agent mode in Xero's demo company; it navigated to reconciliation and matched 29 items but stumbled on prepayments.

method.value: Blake Oliver asked ChatGPT agent mode, which runs in a virtual desktop, to reconcile the checking account in Xero's US demo company. He logged in himself through the takeover button, using a low-permission "accounting agent" user and not trusting the device. The agent opened the 29-item reconcile screen and reported its findings on six transactions. Blake then told it what to do, for example to record a $2,000 deposit as a prepayment.

outcome.value: It found the reconcile screen unprompted and suggested sensible matches. It was slow, though, and it stumbled on the prepayment until it worked it out later in the episode. The excerpt I could read doesn't give a final tally.

notes.value: Use a separate restricted login and don't trust the device, so the agent can't get back in without you. The source says this runs slower than doing it yourself.

source_text.body:
Reconcile bank transactions in Xero with ChatGPT agent mode
Two accountants tested ChatGPT agent mode in Xero's demo company; it navigated to reconciliation and matched 29 items but stumbled on prepayments.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
Blake Oliver asked ChatGPT agent mode, which runs in a virtual desktop, to reconcile the checking account in Xero's US demo company. He logged in himself through the takeover button, using a low-permission "accounting agent" user and not trusting the device. The agent opened the 29-item reconcile screen and reported its findings on six transactions. Blake then told it what to do, for example to record a $2,000 deposit as a prepayment.
How it went
It found the reconcile screen unprompted and suggested sensible matches. It was slow, though, and it stumbled on the prepayment until it worked it out later in the episode. The excerpt I could read doesn't give a final tally.
Worth knowing
Use a separate restricted login and don't trust the device, so the agent can't get back in without you. The source says this runs slower than doing it yourself.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Open [Xero demo company or my accounting software] and go to bank reconciliation for [account]. Match the bank transactions to existing invoices and bills where the amount and payee clearly agree, and list anything uncertain, such as prepayments, without forcing a match. Stop once all clear matches are done and give me the list of the rest. Pause and ask me before posting or changing anything that isn't a plain match.
Original source: https://podscan.fm/podcasts/the-accounting-podcast/episodes/can-chatgpt-agent-mode-reconcile-my-checking-account
